policy: Only FAR pair on beam flange and FAR pair on post flange are active in this106 candidate.

Every NEAR aperture on both outer-top flanges is inactive: cover/disable it in any generic marking layout and do not transfer it to timber. This is a design mask policy, not a qualified physical mask or drilling instruction.
Never use all8 factory holes merely because steel holes exist. Only listed retained axis IDs define the proposed pattern.
The existing horizontal-family STL is FAR-beam-only and has no proved outer-top or post-flange registration. No such qualification is added.
Cleats retain8 bolts per side and center top connections retain4; this outer-top policy must not be applied to other brackets.
